newsitem.title: UK: C&W up after management shakeout report.
newsitem.headline: C&W up after management shakeout report.

text.p: Shares in Cable & Wireless Plc rose in early trading on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times said chief executive Dick Brown was preparing a shakeout of the company's "old guard" of senior managers.
The stock was up 4-1/2p at 456-1/2 by 0807 GMT.

The paper said industry observers saw the exit of strategy and business development director Jonathan Solomon and international services director Edward Astle as evidence Brown wants to sweep out the personalities associated with former chairman Lord Young.
The paper said many in the firm were feeling the pressure as Brown's shake-out extended into personnel and other departments.
